title: Accuracy of wearables for determining the maximal oxygen uptake and lactate threshold: a qualitative systematic review
publisher: Frontiers in Sports and Active Living
claims: Thirteen studies met the inclusion criteria for this review of consumer wearables.
Most included studies investigated Garmin smartwatches with chest-belt heart rate sensors and the Firstbeat algorithm.
Seven studies found wearable devices valid or acceptable for VO2max estimation, and three studies demonstrated validity for lactate threshold estimation.
The authors state that usefulness in elite endurance sport is questionable.
Consumer wearables are not subject to the same regulatory accuracy requirements as medical devices.
